Unlock the booth

Changes are saved straight to the website's GitHub repository, and the site updates itself a minute or so later. You need a GitHub access token for that. It stays on this device only.

How do I get a token?
  1. Open GitHub → Settings → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token.
  2. Name it something like Portfolio admin and pick an expiry.
  3. Under Repository access, choose Only select repositories and pick this site's repository.
  4. Under Permissions → Repository permissions set Contents to Read and write. Optionally set Actions to Read-only so the booth can tell you when the site is live.
  5. Generate, copy the token and paste it above.
